resale_co.name: Certificate of Resale Compliance (Certificate of Residential Resale Compliance)
resale_co.issued_by: Department of Code Enforcement and Zoning, 49 Dolan Street
resale_co.lead_time: Code requires applying at least 10 business days before the sale; fees rise when the inspection is scheduled 10 or fewer business days before closing. Resale inspections are held Mondays and Wednesdays.
resale_co.valid_for: 60 days from the date of issue
requirements: Working smoke and CO alarms on every level and within 10 feet of sleeping areas (smoke: 10-year sealed or hardwired interconnected; CO under 7 years old; UL/ETL listed)
Exit doors open from inside without a key (no double-keyed deadbolts)
Handrail or guard on stairs with 3 or more steps or open sides over 30 inches
House numbers visible from the street and at least 4 inches tall
Walls, ceilings, floors, windows, doors and screens in good repair
Outlets, switches and boxes working with cover plates; no extension cords in place of permanent wiring
Bathroom window or exhaust fan; hot water at least 110 F; no leaks
Stove anti-tip device; only one kitchen in a single-family home
Basement, attic or garage bedrooms must meet habitable space rules (egress windows, two exits) or the inspection fails
Water heater, furnace, boiler and vents safe and working
Electric panel covered; secondary power source warning labels if the home has solar or a generator
All required permits for replaced appliances, systems and improvements obtained and closed by a licensed contractor ('as-is' sales are not exempt)
Roof, gutters, foundation, fireplace and chimney in good repair; yard clean and maintained
Pool over 18 inches deep fenced at least 48 inches high with self-closing, self-latching gate
Water curb stop must work; open permits and code issues resolved before the certificate is issued

fees.label: Resale inspection scheduled more than 10 business days before closing
fees.quote: Inspections requests scheduled more than ten (10) business days prior to the closing date shall have a fee of one hundred ($100.00) dollars. The initial re-inspection, if necessary, shall have no fee.

fees.label: Resale inspection scheduled 4 to 10 business days before closing
fees.quote: Inspections requested to be scheduled four to ten (10) business days prior to the closing shall have a fee of one hundred fifty ($150.00) dollars.

fees.label: First reinspection when inspection was scheduled 4 to 10 business days before closing
fees.quote: The initial re-inspection, if necessary, shall have a fee seventy-five ($75.00) dollars.

fees.label: Resale inspection scheduled less than 4 business days before closing
fees.quote: Inspections requested to be scheduled less than four business days prior to closing shall have a fee of two hundred dollars ($200.00).

fees.label: First reinspection when inspection was scheduled less than 4 business days before closing
fees.quote: The initial re-inspection, if necessary, shall have a fee one hundred ($100.00) dollars.

fees.label: Each additional reinspection after a denial
fees.quote: The fee for each additional reinspection that may be necessary resulting from any denial shall be one hundred fifty ($150.00) dollars.

fees.label: 'AS IS' letter in lieu of the certificate (at the Director's discretion)
fees.quote: The fee for an "AS IS" letter is three hundred ($300.00) dollars.

resale_co.how_to_apply: Apply online through the Borough's FastTrackGov citizen portal ('Apply for a Rental or Resale Inspection'): create an account, complete the application, and the office emails the fee (usually within one business day). Pay online and request a preferred inspection date (resales on Monday and Wednesday); the office confirms by email.

evidence.quote: Certificate of Resale Compliance for all property at time of sale.
evidence.doc_date: Ord. No. 25-22, 9-12-2022 (latest amendment listed; code Supplement 48, 2026-06)

evidence.quote: The owner shall make application for an inspection under this section at least ten (10) business days prior to the intended date of sale or other form of change in ownership.
The certificate of rental and resale compliance as set forth above shall be valid for a period of sixty (60) days from the date of issue.
All said fees shall be paid with the application for inspection and/or with the request for re-inspection.
Compliance Requirement: All applicable items on this checklist must be in compliance and inspected prior to closing.

resale_co.notes: Fees and rules are from Borough Code section 12-3.5 (Property Rental and Resale Inspection), last amended by Ord. No. 25-22 on 9-12-2022, read through the Municode library (code Supplement 48, posted June 2026). The code fee is per certificate; no separate two-family fee is listed. Buyers can take on correction of violations with a conditional certificate (30 days, extendable to 90 days); rentals need a separate Certificate of Rental Compliance. Kirk J. Miick is Director of Code Enforcement (the Borough contact page lists him as Director/Construction & Fire Subcode Official). The Code Enforcement office is at 49 Dolan Street (Code Enforcement 732-390-7028).

requirements: Standalone battery smoke alarms must be 10-year sealed units; smoke alarms must be less than 10 years old
Hardwired or interconnected alarms kept as installed; wireless interconnected alarms do not replace hardwired systems; repairs may need a licensed electrician
Alarms on every finished level, in basements (near the stairs), in finished attics, and outside each sleeping area within 10 feet of bedroom doors
CO alarms within 10 feet of all sleeping areas and less than 7 years old (or as the maker requires)
All alarms must carry a UL, ETL or equal testing-lab label; security-system detectors do not count
Fresh batteries in any alarm that uses replaceable batteries
'CAUTION: MULTIPLE SOURCES OF POWER' printed label within 18 inches of the main panel and meter for homes with solar, battery storage or generators
Portable fire extinguishers are no longer required (effective February 3, 2025)

fees.label: Reinspection (missing, outdated or non-working equipment, or no one present) or cancellation with less than 24 hours notice
fees.quote: A fee of fifty ($50.00) dollars shall be paid for any re-inspection required as a result of any missing, out dated, or non-working life safety equipment or failure of the applicant or applicant's agent not being present for the inspection.

authorities.how_to_apply: The Borough's 'Selling Your Home' page lists the Fire Prevention Resale Checklist with the resale application steps (online portal). Questions: Fire Prevention, 49 Dolan Street, 732-390-7009.

fire_cert.notes: The smoke/CO certificate is separate from the Borough's Certificate of Resale Compliance and is issued by the Bureau of Fire Prevention. Fees are from Borough Code section 15-1.7 (last amended by Ord. 311-15 in November 2015), read through the Municode library; the code text spells 'days' as 'davs' and lists the second and third tiers without a $ sign. The state fire directory's smoke detector compliance block for Sayreville lists 'City of South Amboy Hg/Code Enf' at 140 N Broadway, South Amboy, which conflicts with the Borough's own pages; the Borough's pages are used here. The Fire Official's office is at 49 Dolan Street (Borough FAQ); the 2026 requirements sheet letterhead gives 167 Main Street and 732-390-7009. The Fire Prevention web page title still mentions fire extinguishers, but its text and the 2026 sheet say extinguishers are no longer required.

other_items.label: Open permits
other_items.detail: Contact Code Enforcement when the home is first listed to check for open permits; unpermitted water heaters, furnaces or finished basements can hold up the certificate.

other_items.label: Water curb stop
other_items.detail: The water curb stop must be working; contact the Sayreville Water Department at 732-390-7060 before closing.

other_items.label: 'As is' sales
other_items.detail: Houses sold 'as-is' are not exempt from the permit requirements; the Director may issue an 'AS IS' letter ($300) for a property in such disrepair that compliance cannot be obtained, with conditions to be met within 30 days of closing.

open_questions: Whether the smoke/CO certificate is applied for through the same online portal as the resale certificate (the Fire Prevention page does not say).
